sections.zh:
尽管关于我们的起源（肇始）无处可寻，可以确定的是我们那尚未开智的先祖们是随着一颗庞大的陨石来到[GetHomeWorldName]的，陨石撞击带来了烈焰与灾难，星球上的土著居民大多未能幸免。

千万年已经过去，最初的[GetSpeciesName]逐渐遍布[GetHomeWorldName]全球，不断进化，繁衍生息。我们的文明不断传播并走向繁荣，随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们已准备好探索这片星海。
sections.en:
While our true origins are unknown, we do know that our presapient ancestors arrived on a vast meteorite which slammed into [GetHomeWorldName] in a fiery cataclysm and wiped out most of the native inhabitants.

In the eons since, the first primitive [GetSpeciesName] spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], evolved, and multiplied. Our civilization has spread and prospered, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] we stand ready to explore the galaxy.

summary.text:
# 降世灾星 / Calamitous Birth

- 分类 Category：起源 Origins · DLC：Lithoids Species Pack · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`common/governments/civics/00_origins.txt:2274-2325`、`events/origin_events_3.txt:130-148`

> 本导读是审阅者的说明文字，不是游戏原文。 This guide is reviewer commentary, not game text.

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要岩石物种。殖民时隐藏事件 origin.3010 在目标行星留下两处“被埋葬的岩石生物”矿藏与陨石坑修正（lithoid_crater）。
Requires a lithoid species. When a lithoid colonizer lands, hidden origin.3010 leaves two buried-lithoid deposits and the lithoid_crater modifier on the planet.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

没有叙事窗口；通用异常 anomaly.660 有该起源的分支。
No story windows; the generic anomaly.660 has a branch for this origin.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无。 None.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

可选条件见起源卡。 Requirements are on the origin card.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：起源定义、开局设置与全部事件目录中对该起源的引用。 The origin definition, its start setup and every reference to the origin in the events folder.
- 结论 Result：卡片型起源，没有专属事件窗口。 A card-only origin with no origin-specific windows.
